title: Color / Core brand colors
slide_intent: Assign colors different jobs because recognition and hierarchy depend on more than collecting attractive swatches.
strategic_value: Repeating Feather Green while giving other colors defined roles can make Duolingo familiar and its communications orderly.
demonstration: Four numbered swatches provide digital and print values for Feather Green, Mask Green, Eel and Snow, beside a role hierarchy.
practical_value: Choose a color by its role: core brand hue, backdrop for Duo, typography or primary background.

content_islands.name: Core swatches
content_islands.spec: Keep each numbered color with its name and digital/print values in the left specimen area.

content_islands.name: Role hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Use the right column for the heading and numbered explanation of brand green, secondary green, type gray and background white.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says Feather Green is the hue associated with Duolingo and traces the core palette to Duo.
reference_purposes.Application: The numbered explanation assigns Mask Green as a backdrop for Duo, Eel commonly to typography and Snow as primary background.
reference_purposes.Expression: The four swatches establish the core palette.

ingredient.name: Core color roles
ingredient.role: Build recognition while separating supporting visual jobs.
ingredient.application: Prioritize Feather Green #58CC02; use Mask Green #89E219 as the secondary green backdrop for Duo, Eel #4B4B4B commonly for type and Snow #FFFFFF as primary background.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical core palette. The hierarchy is qualitative; swatch areas do not prescribe usage percentages.
